name: Score-Based Generative Modeling with SDEs
name_zh: 基于随机微分方程的得分生成建模
summary: Represent perturbation and generative processes with forward/reverse SDEs and learned score fields.
summary_zh: 通过扰动分布的得分函数构造反向时间SDE与概率流ODE进行生成。
core_idea: Learn time-dependent score gradients and use reverse-time SDE or probability-flow ODE sampling.
innovation: Unifies score-based models with stochastic continuous-time generative dynamics, including paths related to diffusion models.
limitations: Reverse integration and score approximation introduce numerical errors.
Sampling physical fields requires additional validity checks.

start_here.why: Foundational SDE view connecting score models and diffusion.
start_here.focus: Reverse-time SDE, probability-flow ODE and score estimation.

curation_note: Bibliographic identity verified against authoritative proceedings; downstream physical inverse validity must be separately evaluated.
